imagery.source: Hellenic Cadastre (Ktimatologio) orthophoto basemap, open WMS http://gis.ktimanet.gr/wms/wmsopen/wmsserver.aspx layer BASEMAP, EPSG:2100
imagery.nativeResolutionNote: estimated from the block size of a 5 cm/px request (about 10 px blocks); requested at 0.1 m/px
imagery.termsSummary: No distribution policy announced yet; any commercial use or exploitation of the viewing service is expressly forbidden; otherwise ktimatologio.gr terms apply. A watermark ('Ktimatologio') is burnt into the tiles. Imagery and overlay kept in refs/ortho/ (gitignored), not redistributed.

northColonnadeLine.note: dark band of the north colonnade bases (ground level); + = the photo axis is turned toward temple north (counter-clockwise) relative to the model

temple.edgeNote: half-max of the non-gravel fraction (grey < 240); north edge hidden by the colonnade shadows, east edge merged with the ramp foundations, so only west and south are usable; the south edge may be pushed out by fallen drums

terraceWallsNote: photo edge = strongest bright-gravel -> dark step across each model wall; offset is measured from the model's inner face at mid-length (+ = photo edge further out), angle = photo edge vs model wall (+ = turned counter-clockwise seen from above)

notIdentified.altar: foundation not separable from the ruin field east of the ramp at 0.5 m GSD (several candidate gray bands, none clearly 13 x 2.6 m)
notIdentified.propylon: south of the terrace edge the ruins are dense; a wall angle near the model's south-wall turn is visible but cannot be matched to the propylon walls with confidence
notIdentified.terrace-wall-se: the east part of the south wall: a wall angle near frame (36-41, 17-21) is visible but ambiguous
notIdentified.se-rooms-ii-iv: walls visible with the model's orientation (NW-SE), overlap within about 2-3 m, but individual rooms are not resolvable
notIdentified.cistern: not visible (small shaft, ruins and trees around)
notIdentified.suedbau-north-wall: under tree canopy / outside the clear area

summary.templeAlongAxisNote: photo west krepis edge minus the model's (+ = photo further east); the east edge is merged with the ramp
summary.templeAcrossAxisNote: photo south krepis edge minus the model's (+ = further south); probably widened by fallen drums; the north band sits 1.6 m outside the model column row, so the across-axis centre agrees within about 1 m
summary.rotationNote: + = photo turned counter-clockwise from above relative to the model, i.e. the true axis bearing would be this much smaller; the terrace walls come from the 1911 plan registered to the temple, so they test plan + georef together
